checkpoint: verified official T15 GRU cache with no reporting labels
scope: 24 deterministic length-quantile tuning trials including the longest trial; score only the first pass, and repeat requests for a sustained pilot
ngram_context_update: Train-only three-gram steers the beam between refreshes. Each neural refresh replaces the accumulated context score so prior refresh scores are not added again.
endpoint: Use the upstream two neutral tail frames to close lexical boundaries. Preserve all original frame values and count feature duration from raw frames.
reporting: Development diagnostic on a declared subset. Requires a separate admission and freeze for a wider exploratory comparison.
